cards.english: You look great!
To find a common language (to understand each other).
He ran ten kilometers.
The salary is fifty thousand.
March eighth is a holiday.
He runs every other day.
He lives on the third floor.

cards.target: Площадь, на которой стоит памятник, красивая.
cards.english: The square on which the monument stands is beautiful.

cards.target: На вкус и цвет товарищей нет.
cards.english: There's no accounting for taste.

cards.target: Тише ты, ребёнок спит в соседней комнате!
cards.english: Quiet down, the child is sleeping in the next room!

cards.target: Родина – мать, умей за неё постоять.
cards.english: The motherland is a mother, know how to stand up for her.

cards.target: Моя дочь перешла в пятый класс этой осенью.
cards.english: My daughter moved to fifth grade this autumn.

cards.target: Он весь день считает ворон вместо того чтобы работать.
cards.english: He counts crows all day instead of working.

cards.target: Не откладывай на завтра то, что можно сделать сегодня.
cards.english: Don't put off until tomorrow what can be done today.

cards.target: У них на даче четыре собаки, и они каждый день подолгу с ними гуляют.
cards.english: They have four dogs at the dacha, and every day they walk them for a long time.
The seventh wonder of the world.
Give half a kilo of cheese.
Truth pokes the eyes (truth hurts).
You could poke out an eye (pitch dark).
To notch on the nose (to remember firmly).
To wind on the mustache (to take note).
To look through fingers (to turn a blind eye).
Repetition is the mother of learning.
The sixth lesson is the most difficult.
As behind a stone wall (feeling protected).
Written with pitchforks on water (very uncertain).
There are a thousand rubles in the account.
The temperature is minus ten degrees.
Thousands of tourists visit this city.
Hundreds of people came to the concert.
The Snow Maiden is Grandfather Frost's granddaughter.
The apple doesn't fall far from the tree.
An old friend is better than two new ones.
The mountain's height is five thousand meters.

cards.target: В России зимы холодные и снежные.
cards.english: In Russia winters are cold and snowy.

cards.target: Русские отмечают Новый год с размахом.
cards.english: Russians celebrate New Year with great fanfare.

cards.target: Через пять лет он окончит университет.
cards.english: In five years he will graduate from university.
When there's no fish, a crayfish is a fish.
Wherever you throw, there's a wedge (no way out).

cards.target: Позвольте поблагодарить вас за оказанное гостеприимство.
cards.english: Allow me to thank you for the hospitality shown.

cards.target: Благодарю вас за тёплый приём и гостеприимство.
cards.english: Thank you for the warm reception and hospitality.

cards.target: Шахматист обдумывал каждый ход с невероятной сосредоточенностью.
cards.english: The chess player contemplated each move with incredible concentration.

cards.target: Пастух гнал стадо через туманные горные пастбища.
cards.english: The shepherd drove the herd across the foggy mountain pastures.

cards.target: Самолёт летит на высоте десять тысяч метров.
cards.english: The plane flies at an altitude of ten thousand meters.

cards.target: Ладно, забей, это не так уж и важно.
cards.english: Alright, forget it, it's not that important.

cards.target: Шляпник создавал элегантные головные уборы для нового сезона.
cards.english: The hatmaker designed elegant headwear for the new season.

cards.target: Не имей сто рублей, а имей сто друзей.
cards.english: Don't have a hundred rubles, have a hundred friends.

cards.target: Можно вас спросить, как пройти к ближайшему метро?
cards.english: May I ask you how to get to the nearest metro?

cards.target: Крепко обнимаю тебя и жду встречи на каникулах!
cards.english: I hug you tight and can't wait to see you over the holidays!

cards.target: Она знала, что, если опоздает, начальник будет недоволен.
cards.english: She knew that if she was late, the boss would be unhappy.

cards.target: Не могли бы вы подождать несколько минут в коридоре?
cards.english: Could you wait a few minutes in the corridor?

cards.target: Пока художник рисует в мастерской, спортсмен бегает в парке.
cards.english: While the artist paints in his studio, the athlete runs in the park.

cards.target: Не могли бы вы уделить мне несколько минут вашего времени?
cards.english: Could you spare me a few minutes of your time?

cards.target: Очень приятно познакомиться, я слышал много хорошего о вашей работе.
cards.english: Very pleased to meet you, I have heard many good things about your work.

cards.target: Он ни рыба ни мясо, не может решить, на чьей он стороне.
cards.english: He's neither fish nor fowl, he can't decide whose side he's on.
To lead by the nose (to deceive).
To sit on someone's neck (to be a burden).
Hunger is not an auntie (hunger is a tough master).
The first pancake is a lump (first attempt is imperfect).
We drove a thousand kilometers.
The twentieth century was turbulent.
Millions of stars in the sky.
To hang noodles on ears (to deceive).
A bear stepped on the ear (tone-deaf).
A stick with two ends (a double-edged sword).
May ninth is Victory Day.
We are sitting in the fourth row.
Where it's thin, it tears (the weakest link breaks).
Speech is silver, silence is gold.

cards.target: Скрипичный мастер изготовил инструмент из лучшего клёна.
cards.english: The violin maker crafted an instrument from the finest maple.

cards.target: Кукольник управлял фигурками на тонких нитях перед зрителями.
cards.english: The puppeteer controlled the figures on thin strings before the audience.

cards.target: С уважением, Иванов – это стандартный способ завершить официальное письмо по-русски.
cards.english: Respectfully yours, Ivanov, this is the standard way to close a formal letter in Russian.
